Name: Fairy Weaponry
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]Bring fantasy to your valley with six new magical weapons, they can be very powerful or not (I tried my best to balance :P).

The Dwarf can create these weapons if you have the required items, you also need a Prism in a Bottle to see the weapons. It's recommended to have an empty slot for the weapon you want.

List of weapons:
[spoiler]
[b]Woodland Staff:[/b]
Summons three thorns from the earth to attack enemies.

[b]Fairy Tome: [/b]
[s]Yes, you can use the book to fight.[/s] Summons three fairies that can bounce thrice before hitting an enemy.

[b]Radiant Staff:[/b]
Fires three prismatic rays that deal damage to enemies.

[b]Fairy Staff:[/b]
Fires nine prismatic rays that deal damage to enemies.

[b]Sky Splitter:[/b]
Dashes a long distance and then attacks repeatedly. 
[/spoiler]
List of Items:
[spoiler]
[b]Prismatic Mushroom:[/b]
Secret Woods in Spring.
Must have Farming Level 5.

[b]Mysterious Note[/b][b]:[/b]
Secret Woods in Fall.
Must have Farming Level 5.

[b]Ancient Acorn[/b][b]:[/b]
Secret Woods in Winter.
Must have Farming Level 5.

[b]Prism in a Bottle:[/b]
2 Prismatic Mushroom + 10 Solar Essence.
Must have Farming Level 5.

[b]Prismatic Pearl:[/b]
Island Trader for 1 Prismatic Shard.
[/spoiler][/size]
